_comment: The shouts a player may hold: Give all Shouts (adminSystem.ts reads admin-powers.json) and the combat shout gate (combat.js) use only these. Editor id + plugin; vanilla's 20 Dragonborn shouts, Dawnguard's 3 and Dragonborn's 4. Left out on purpose (16 Oct, Nate: 'it gave me every shout that you shouldnt have'): dragon, Alduin, Miraak, Durnehviir, Greybeard, draugr and quest copies; racial powers (Battle Cry, Voice of the Emperor, Command Animal), which the race already gives; werewolf howls (beastform.js); creature shouts from mods (arnima, Druadach, Helgen Reborn, Journey to Baan Malur). ck-mcp/admin_powers.py writes every SHOU; filter its output through this list.
